mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, reducing the hepatic metabolism and activation of clopidogrel's active metabolite, thereby decreasing antiplatelet efficacy.
action: Consider alternative antibiotic (e.g., azithromycin or doxycycline) or use clopidogrel at higher maintenance doses with increased monitoring; separate dosing timing if possible.
